name: Xin Zhao
notes: Crescent Guard (R) is cast at t=0 as the engine's forced opening ultimate, which is also optimal since its 15%-of-current-health term is largest against a full-health dummy.
Wind Becomes Lightning (W) and Audacious Charge (E) are then cast as soon as each comes off cooldown, with W preferred on simultaneous readiness, and recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight.

Three Talon Strike (Q) is cast the instant it is off cooldown and not already armed; its post-effect cooldown starts when the third empowered attack lands, or, if the 5s window lapses before that happens, when the window expires (so the cooldown timer always advances even against a slow-attacking build).

Each empowered Three Talon Strike attack resets Xin Zhao's basic attack timer and shaves 1 second off W's and E's current cooldowns; the identical 1 second shave to Crescent Guard's 100+ second cooldown is omitted since it can never come off cooldown again within a single fight.

Determination's bonus physical damage (every third stack, from basic-attack on-hit or W's first slash/thrust) is modeled as non-crit proc damage that does not itself count as ability damage, per the wiki's explicit description; its life-steal-based heal is not modeled since healing is irrelevant to the dummy fight.

Wind Becomes Lightning's first slash lands instantly on cast, the next three slashes follow every 0.05 s, and the thrust lands at the end of the 0.5 s cast time (see assumed for the cast-time discrepancy); the thrust's damage is amplified by 0.333x Xin Zhao's crit chance rather than critically striking.

Audacious Charge's bonus attack speed uses the wiki's literal '+1% attack speed per 5% of Xin Zhao's own non-buff bonus attack speed' reading (see assumed) applied to the build's static bonus attack speed, since it and the AP-to-AS term don't change mid-fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Xin Zhao's costs bind within an 8-15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: wiki states 0.5s cast time while Riot's bin field for W lists 0.6s; the wiki figure lines up with the documented 0.15s slash window plus remaining cast, so it is used, per the dossier's open question

the bin's PermanentASToASRatio=5 doesn't obviously match the wiki's literal '+1% AS per 5% bonus AS from non-buff sources'; the wiki's literal reading (coefficient 0.2) is used as the more directly documented number
